profile.headline: Software Development Engineer II at Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Led the end-to-end automation of localization processes for multiple large-scale Content Management Systems (CMS), decreasing manual processing times from 3 business days to 2 hours, achieving a 90% efficiency gain and completely eliminating manual error.
- Architected and implemented an automated cloud storage localization workflow, transforming a labor-intensive, 8-day manual task into a seamless, hands-off process that executes in just 15 minutes—saving 99% of operations engineers’ time and resources.
- Directed the migration from manual AWS resource management to Cloud Development Kit (CDK) deployment pipelines, cutting major infrastructure optimization cycles down from 6 months to 2 weeks, and driving enhanced reliability, consistency, and auditing of deployments.
- Designed and launched comprehensive automation of code and operational pipelines, exponentially scaling onboarding throughput from 2–5 clients per month to 10–15 clients per week.
- Instituted process improvements and workloads optimizations that avoided a projected fourfold increase in team headcount (from 5 to 20), keeping resource needs manageable with only 3 contingent hires, while scaling output and quality.
- Established real-time automated monitoring and QA systems, reducing localization-related production defects from 3–5 per week to just 1–2 per quarter, even with increased scale and traffic.
- Increased system capacity from handling 300–500 localization projects weekly to 3,500–5,000, and as high as 15,000 daily requests during peak periods such as re:Invent, while consistently maintaining >98% uptime, even amid occasional downstream disruptions.
- Championed the adoption of DevOps practices, cloud-native architectures, and cutting-edge technology pilots, fostering a resilient, scalable, and adaptable engineering culture committed to operational excellence.

positions.title: Cloud Support Engineer II
positions.description:
- Demonstrated expert-level mastery across the AWS ecosystem, supporting and advising public sector, enterprise, and SMB clients on mission-critical workloads and architectures.
- Delivered world-class, customer-obsessed technical support—identified, diagnosed, and resolved challenging issues across AWS compute, storage, networking, security, and application services.
- Guided customers through key architectural decisions, integration strategies, automation opportunities, and best practice implementations to achieve high performance, security, and resilience.
- Developed tools, scripts, monitoring solutions, and automations that reduced case resolution times by up to 60%, increased support team efficiency, and eliminated error-prone manual steps.
- Authored 20+ technical tutorials, how-to articles, and explainer video scripts to educate both customers and internal support teams, driving community learning and adoption of AWS best practices.
- Provided mentorship, technical coaching, onboarding guidance, and code reviews to new and established AWS Support Engineers—fostering an environment of continuous growth and knowledge sharing.
- Designed and delivered formal and informal training programs for both colleagues and customers, accelerating learning and raising technical standards.
- Reduced customer effort and friction through automation of repetitive troubleshooting and process workflows, directly increasing customer satisfaction and AWS case closure metrics.
- Led and managed war rooms for major incidents, coordinating cross-team efforts and ensuring post-incident review and knowledge dissemination across global teams.
- Drove knowledge sharing, team building, and continuous improvement through regular retrospectives, peer learning sessions, and innovation sprints.
- Received repeated recognition from customers, peers, and AWS leadership for technical excellence, communication skills, initiative, and customer advocacy.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Defined, designed, and proposed alternative technical solutions for 5+ projects, ensuring rapid adaptation to evolving business needs and maximizing value delivery.
- Led application enhancements that improved overall system performance by 70% and enabled seamless connectivity between sales offices and headquarters, eliminating the need for dedicated network devices for truck customization data exchange.
- Performed troubleshooting and systems administration across multiple projects, ensuring reliable operation and swift resolution of issues to support uninterrupted business operations.
- Analyzed and communicated complex technical requirements for 5+ project teams, designing robust solutions that consistently met and exceeded business objectives.
- Conducted pre-project consulting and developed comprehensive business cases, driving strategic decision-making for all major initiatives.
- Elicited high-level project objectives and success criteria, resulting in clear project alignment and measurable outcomes.
- Identified and managed dependencies between interconnected projects and systems, facilitating timely and integrated solution delivery.
- Collaborated with business analysts and internal teams to gather and deliver technical requirements for web services, interfaces, and GUI designs on multiple projects.
- Spearheaded Agile methodology adoption within the organization—migrating from a waterfall model—resulting in higher delivery accuracy, improved tracking of both individual and team efforts, and more effective resource allocation.
- Introduced and standardized software development best practices including unit testing and stub/mock testing, substantially reducing regression failures after each feature release.
- Participated in detailed workshop sessions to scope and define requirements, ensuring all project deliverables aligned with customer and business goals.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Engineering · Software Design · .NET · Testing

positions.title: Sr Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
- Built robust public and internal-facing Web Service APIs for Getty Images, enabling reliable and scalable digital asset access across the organization.
- Designed APIs to deliver core functionality and data services within a complex, heterogeneous enterprise environment.
- Developed and optimized middle-tier components and databases to efficiently support high-traffic Web Services applications.
- Collaborated and coordinated with cross-functional teams using Agile/Scrum methodologies to deliver high-quality features on schedule.
- Practiced active pair programming, incorporating behavior-driven and test-driven development (BDD/TDD) processes to ensure code quality and maintainability.
- Supported production environments in partnership with development and operations teams, performing performance tuning and code optimization for maximum reliability and speed.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET · BDD · Pair Programming · SQL · Functional Testing

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built big-data analysis, experimentation, and reporting tools supporting search-engine product decisions.
- Developed big-data analysis and executive reporting solutions with SQL and ASP.NET, informing strategic product and business decisions.
- Designed and automated ad hoc reporting applications that extracted and analyzed experiment (flight) KPI data from COSMOS, enabling rapid evaluation of treatments and operational changes.
- Built custom analytical and testing tools for feature evaluation across multiple search engines, improving product quality and performance.
- Architected and tuned high-capacity reporting database schemas using execution plans, SQL Profiler, and data partitioning.
- Built data-driven Windows Services and ASP.NET applications to automate reporting and business processes.
- Led scope analysis, requirements gathering, and high- and low-level design for reporting projects.

positions.title: Technology Analyst
positions.description:
- Delivered web applications, workflow automation, and data solutions on the Microsoft stack for enterprise clients.
- Designed and built ASP.NET websites, customizing business workflows to match client processes.
- Designed electronic forms in InfoPath and automated approval and data-collection processes on SharePoint sites, replacing manual, paper- and email-based steps.
- Designed and optimized relational database schemas for reporting and line-of-business applications, using execution plans and SQL Profiler for performance tuning.
- Developed data-driven ASP.NET applications and Windows Services to automate business processes and reporting.
- Gathered and analyzed requirements and produced high- and low-level system designs.

positions.title: Technical Leader
positions.description:
Complete integration of transaction lifecycle among customer suppliers and invoice approvers

Successful implementation of the different business processes of customers, sometimes through third-parties, back to the company framework for online invoice processing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Sql Server DBA for Remittance system that transferred wire transactions from USA headed to America, Europe and Asia.

Developed monitor applications for remittance queue sent from USA to all the different payment associates across different countries.

positions.title: Software Engineer Junior
positions.description: Developed 3-tier application using ASP, SQL Server 2000 and COM+ objects for business applications and budget approval workflows. Requirement Analyst and Application design were also my responsabilities.
